_note: Cost ledger for the pytest tiers. Per tier: the marker expression it selects on, the node ids it collected when this record was written, and the wall time a human measured for it. `tiers` are the Taskfile tasks (their expressions are read back from Taskfile.yml); `witness` are the jobs of .github/workflows/witness.yml (their expression, test path and timeout are read back from the workflow). tests/test_marker_drift.py re-collects every tier (collection only -- no test run) and fails when a tier no longer collects what is recorded here, when a recorded expression stops being the one the task or job runs, when a `measured` date is older than 30 days, and when a row's `wall_seconds` exceeds its optional `budget_seconds` (only rows that declare one are checked; only the edit loop does -- the 30s contract); the counts stated in docs/how-to/test-loop.md are checked against this file. Re-record the collected sets after a deliberate tier change with `UPDATE_TIERS=1 uv run --no-sync pytest -q tests/test_marker_drift.py`, then fill wall_seconds/measured by hand from a `time` run of the row's own `command` (each row's note records the conditions it was measured under).
